items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee (Chico Hamilton) does not mention Isaac Hayes. The mention of Isaac Hayes is made by a third party (Mr. Kimery) in the context of discussing a manager who 'managed Isaac Hayes' and 'put the Staple singers, Isaac Hayes' in groups. The interviewee does not confirm a personal relationsh

ctx.x: No, a burger in LA. You know, what was the name? MR. KIMERY: There’s Tommy’s.

No. Fat Burgers. That was one of his products. He managed Isaac Hayes. He was responsible for Isaac getting an Academy Award. Watts Stax, you know, he did all that. He was in management. You know, he was a millionaire when he was 21. His first group was Love and by the time he was 21 years old, man, he had made a million dollars.
